scope: Bounded synthetic fixture verification of document intake; no historical corpus OCR or fresh complete-reading certification.

checks: Two-page native PDF text order, exact SHA identity, unchanged source bytes and valid atomic page PNG outputs.
Image-only PDF reports zero native text and an extraction gap without automatically running OCR.
Mocked missing OCR engine records unavailable capability and does not fabricate recognition validation.
DOCX paragraph-table-paragraph order and optional footer text are retained; page count remains unknown and source bytes remain unchanged.
ZIP parent, absolute and Windows drive paths are flagged; inventory performs no member extraction.
Invalid UTF-8 is rejected explicitly without guessing an encoding or replacing characters.

real_ocr_smoke.fixture: One temporary image-only PDF generated from synthetic English text.
real_ocr_smoke.limit: A matching synthetic phrase establishes a smoke check of the installed English OCR path, not transcription accuracy for arbitrary scans or other languages.

not_claimed: Complete reading of any reference corpus.
Accuracy validation of arbitrary OCR text, charts, equations or source layouts.
OCR testing for Indonesian or other language models.
DOCX pagination, comment resolution, tracked-change acceptance or full visual inspection.
ZIP member content reading, extraction or execution.
